inputsAndSchemas: one reviewed closed flat-object source schema
one explicit field mapping and loss declaration
outputsAndSchemas: one mapping digest bound to successful results
basis.purpose: Build a deterministic bounded object-contract adapter that makes every copied, renamed, defaulted, and dropped top-level field explicit without claiming domain meaning from structural compatibility.
basis.verificationContract: Prove exact mapping coverage, explicit loss, widening-only copies, valid defaults, deterministic rebuild parity, generated selftest behavior, bounded resources, and authority refusal.

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 accepts and emits only the named schemas in its specification.
cases.counterevidence: An undeclared schema is accepted, a declared schema is refused, or an output fails schema validation.
evidenceRequired: input and output schema validation results
cases.passCondition: A verifier exercises every declared input and checks every produced result against the declared output schema.
cases.title: Contract and schema identity

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 completes its stated purpose for one valid bounded input.
cases.counterevidence: The valid operation fails, produces an incomplete output, or performs an undeclared effect.
evidenceRequired: captured result matched to expected output
cases.passCondition: Prove exact mapping coverage, explicit loss, widening-only copies, valid defaults, deterministic rebuild parity, generated selftest behavior, bounded resources, and authority refusal.
cases.title: Positive path

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 rejects missing, malformed, oversized and wrong-version inputs without partial success.
cases.counterevidence: Any invalid input is treated as success, crashes without a bounded receipt, or mutates state.
cases.passCondition: Each invalid-input class returns a typed refusal and leaves the source and target state unchanged.
cases.title: Malformed and missing input refusal

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 operates only inside the declared permission and consent boundary.
cases.counterevidence: The hand acts without required consent, inherits broader authority, or treats missing authority as success.
cases.passCondition: no permissions; callers explicitly provide the source object and retain authority over use of the result
cases.title: Permission and consent refusal

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 creates only the declared side effects.
cases.counterevidence: A filesystem, network, process, persistence, publication or deletion effect occurs outside the specification.
cases.passCondition: none; adaptation is a pure in-memory operation
cases.title: Side-effect confinement

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 stays inside its time, size and work budget and refuses excess safely.
cases.counterevidence: The budget is exceeded without refusal, work continues unbounded, or partial effects survive a limit breach.
cases.passCondition: At most 64 primitive properties, 16 KiB per schema, 64 KiB input, 64 KiB output, no recursion, network, filesystem, clock, environment, or dynamic code.
cases.title: Resource-budget boundary

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 fails and recovers according to its declared contract.
cases.counterevidence: An interrupted operation corrupts source or target state, loops indefinitely, or lacks a usable recovery receipt.
cases.passCondition: Unknown fields, invalid schemas, hidden drops, narrowing copies, incompatible defaults, over-budget input, malformed source values, and invalid target output fail with typed refusal and no retained partial state.
cases.title: Failure and recovery

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 honors its version contract and refuses unknown major versions.
cases.counterevidence: An incompatible major version is silently accepted or a supported version changes behavior without a typed notice.
cases.passCondition: The pilot consumes one exact source contract and provides one exact target contract. It proves successful output shape, declared loss, and deterministic mapping bytes; domain semantic equivalence remains unproven.
cases.title: Compatibility and major-version refusal

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 produces sufficient evidence to inspect the claimed outcome and its boundaries.
cases.counterevidence: A pass depends on absent, inaccessible, stale, circular or purely asserted evidence.
cases.passCondition: Every required verification case has a stable evidence pointer, a concrete observation and a reproducible procedure.
cases.title: Evidence completeness

cases.claim: contract.adapt.closed-object/v1 cannot promote, release, grant authority or change CANON through a test result.
cases.counterevidence: Automation changes promotion, release, authority or CANON state, or bypasses the named human gate.
cases.passCondition: Mike reviews the exact builder source, semantic boundary, test evidence, catalog diff, and composition behavior before activation or merge.
cases.title: Promotion and CANON authority hold
